title: פליק פלופים פלטפורמטיים: גוגל מהדקת, אפל מדממת, והשחקנים בורחים ל-D2C | Ben's Weekly Digest
summary: Google Play implements new mandatory performance requirements for apps and games (memory, DEX optimization) from Feb 2027, with non-compliant apps facing reduced visibility. Zero-Tap Sign-In becomes mandatory for eligible apps from Apr 2027.
